text: The venture arms of Intel, NVIDIA, and AMD all invested in Ayar Labs. According to the chapter, what does this 'strategic capital' most reliably signal?
choices: That optical arithmetic will soon displace GPU compute
That the incumbents expect quantum computing to arrive before classical photonics
That financial-only investors are chasing a compelling narrative
The incumbents' own forecast of where photonics enters the computer first, namely optical I/O
explanation: Strategic capital chases roadmaps: when the three leading compute vendors back the same optical I/O supplier (Ayar Labs sells interconnect, not compute), it is the incumbents forecasting that photonics enters the computer first as I/O. Option 2 describes financial-only capital, and options 0 and 1 misstate both what Ayar sells and what the investment implies.
